query:
SELECT a.id, a.code
        FROM assets AS a
        WHERE a.asset_class = 'fiat'
          AND a.is_active = TRUE
          AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
              a.code = $1
              OR a.id IN (
                  SELECT default_asset_id FROM accounts WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
                  UNION
                  SELECT asset_id FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
              )
          )
        ORDER BY a.code
